scope: PC-only painted 2D iso theme kit for the Crosshaven open-world outskirts (PR #241): Northgate snow + crags. Same grid, file layout and anchors as art/world/crosshaven (crosshaven_art.gd texture(kind,id)).

files.masters: 2x PNG at <kind>/_2x/<id>.png, draw at scale 0.5 (identical placement)

anchors.tile: image bottom-centre (64,64)@2x / (32,32)@1x = diamond south tip; diamond centre (64,32)@2x
anchors.terrace: offset_2x from the LIFTED cell centre (2x); faces drawn before the top tile, lips/corners after
anchors.prop: image bottom-centre on the SOUTH tip of the footprint's south-most cell; 2x1 drifts run back to (x-1,y)

autotile.grass_side: golden_plains (repo art/world/crosshaven/tiles) is what frost_grass meets
autotile.chain: golden_plains -> frost_grass_edge_* -> frost_grass / snow_patch (the common ground) -> snow_edge_* -> snow (crag tops / high ground only)

interior_mix.snow: snow_a/b common, snow_c/d rare - crag tops / high ground only

autotile.edges: <family>_edge_<sides in order nw,ne,se,sw> = floor tile used INSTEAD of the interior when those side neighbours are the outer terrain
autotile.corners: <family>_corner_<n|e|s|w> = decal over the floor when only that diagonal neighbour is the outer terrain

joins.snow_patch: same as frost_grass (it IS frost_grass for autotiling)

autotile.water: water cells keep the repo water_a..d floor; add water_ice_edge_<side> per land side, water_ice_corner_<c> per land-only diagonal, water_ice_a/b on ~1/3 of open cells

lighting.key: top-left (left/SW faces lit, right/SE faces in cool shade)
lighting.shadows: contact AO only (alpha<=0.3), no cast shadows
